name: status-04
description: Regions, each with its status, p95 latency bar and error rate.

files.content:
'use client' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { StatusIndicator, type StatusLevel, getWorstStatus, statusConfig, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/status' import { DataTable, DataTableBar, DataTableBody, DataTableCell, DataTableHead, DataTableHeader, DataTableRow, DataTableRowHead, DataTableStateRows, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/table' import { formatNumber, formatPercent } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' interface Region { code: string /** Share of requests that failed, as a percentage. */ errorRate: number /** p95, in milliseconds. */ latency: number name: string status: StatusLevel } interface Status4Props { /** Defaults to a sentence counting the healthy regions and naming the worst. */ description?: string /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ regions?: Region[] status?: BlockStatus title: string } const exampleProps: Status4Props = { regions: [ { code: 'us-east-1', errorRate: 0.02, latency: 48, name: 'N. Virginia', status: 'operational', }, { code: 'us-west-2', errorRate: 0.03, latency: 61, name: 'Oregon', status: 'operational', }, { code: 'eu-west-1', errorRate: 0.41, latency: 212, name: 'Ireland', status: 'degraded', }, { code: 'eu-central-1', errorRate: 0.01, latency: 57, name: 'Frankfurt', status: 'operational', }, { code: 'ap-south-1', errorRate: 4.8, latency: 890, name: 'Mumbai', status: 'partial', }, { code: 'ap-northeast-1', errorRate: 0.02, latency: 73, name: 'Tokyo', status: 'operational', }, ], title: 'Region health', } const formatErrors = (percent: number) => formatPercent(percent / 100, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) const summarize = (regions: Region[]) => { const healthy = regions.filter((region) => region.status === 'operational').length const count = `${healthy} of ${regions.length} regions healthy.` const worstStatus = getWorstStatus(regions.map((region) => region.status)) const worst = regions .filter((region) => region.status === worstStatus) .sort((a, b) => b.errorRate - a.errorRate)[0] if (!worst || worstStatus === 'operational') return count return `${count} ${worst.name} ${statusConfig[worst.status].phrase}, with ${formatErrors(worst.errorRate)} of requests failing.` } const Status4 = (props: Status4Props) => { const { regions = [], status, title } = props const { description = summarize(regions) } = props const state = getBlockState(status, regions) const slowest = Math.max(...regions.map((region) => region.latency), 0) return (

{title}

{description}
Region Status p95 latency Errors {!state && regions.map((region) => ( {region.name} {region.code} {region.latency > 0 ? `${formatNumber(region.latency)} ms` : '—'} {formatErrors(region.errorRate)} ))}
) } export { Status4, exampleProps as status4ExampleProps, type Status4Props }
